$comment: The same request in the canonical vocabulary. `medium` is Gemini's level, so this compiles
for google with nothing to say — the loss is entirely on the OUT side, and the two
to-<dialect>.json fixtures commit it: openai-chat rounds up to `high`, anthropic-messages
drops the hint. That asymmetry is the argument for the union-not-intersection rule:
taking the intersection would make `medium` unsayable to the one dialect that has it.
